title: Modern Operations, Reliability and Resilience

header.html: 6.2 Describe the fundamental concepts of modern operations, reliability and resilience in the cloud: modernizing operations with Google Cloud Observability (operations suite, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, Cloud Profiler, Error Reporting); operations terms (operational excellence, reliability, high availability); designing resilient infrastructure (redundancy, replication, scalable infrastructure, backups); measuring performance and reliability (latency, traffic, saturation, errors); DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SLIs, SLOs, SLAs)
the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide

toc.title: Measuring performance and reliability: the golden signals

html:
1Operations terms

Term Meaning
Operational excellence Running systems well: efficient, automated, continuously improved
Reliability The system does what users expect, when they expect it
High availability (HA) Minimal downtime, often by removing single points of failure
Resilience Withstanding and recovering from failure

2Google Cloud Observability

Observability means seeing what is happening inside your systems so you can fix problems fast.

Product What it shows
Cloud Monitoring Metrics, dashboards and alerts about health and performance
Cloud Logging Logs from applications and services, searchable
Cloud Trace How long requests take as they travel through services (latency)
Cloud Profiler Which parts of the code use the most CPU and memory
Error Reporting Collects and groups application errors

Together they form the operations suite (Google Cloud Observability).

Exam tip

. Metrics and alerts → Monitoring. Logs → Logging. Slow requests → Trace. Heavy code → Profiler. Crashes and exceptions → Error Reporting.

3Designing resilient infrastructure

Technique Meaning
Redundancy Extra copies of components so one failure does not stop service
Replication Copy data across zones or regions
Scalable infrastructure Add capacity to meet demand (autoscaling)
Backups Copies to restore after loss or mistakes

Use multiple zones for high availability and multiple regions for disaster recovery.

4Measuring performance and reliability: the golden signals

Signal Question
Latency How long does a request take?
Traffic How much demand is the system handling?
Saturation How full is the system (CPU, memory, capacity)?
Errors How many requests fail?

5DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)

DevOps joins development and operations for faster, more reliable releases through automation and shared ownership. SRE applies software engineering to operations.

Term Meaning Example
Service level indicator (SLI) A measurement of service behavior Percent of requests served in under 300 milliseconds
Service level objective (SLO) The target for an SLI 99.9 percent of requests succeed
Service level agreement (SLA) A contract: what the provider promises and the remedy if it fails Credits if availability falls below the promise

An error budget is how much unreliability the SLO allows; it balances speed of change and stability.

Exam tip

. SLI measures, SLO targets, SLA promises. The SLA is the contract; the SLO is the internal goal.

Exam tip

. Use the SRE words precisely: an SLI is measured, an SLO is the target, an SLA is the contract. Observability tells you what is wrong; resilience keeps the service up.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A team wants dashboards and alerts about the health and performance of its services. Which product fits?

  • ACloud Trace, which follows request timing
  • BCloud Profiler, which analyzes code usage
  • CCloud Monitoring, which shows metrics and alerts
  • DError Reporting, which groups application errors
Show the answer

Answer: C. Cloud Monitoring provides metrics, dashboards and alerts.

S2A developer wants to see which function in the code uses the most CPU. Which product fits?

  • ACloud Logging
  • BCloud Monitoring
  • CCloud Trace
  • DCloud Profiler
Show the answer

Answer: D. Cloud Profiler shows which parts of the code consume the most CPU and memory.

S3A company wants to find which service in a chain of calls makes requests slow. Which product fits?

  • AError Reporting, which collects exceptions
  • BCloud Storage, which stores objects
  • CCloud Billing, which reports costs
  • DCloud Trace, which shows request latency
Show the answer

Answer: D. Cloud Trace shows how long requests take as they pass through services.

S4Which design helps an application stay available if one data center area fails?

  • AA single large server in one zone
  • BRedundancy across several zones
  • CA nightly backup stored in the same server
  • DA bigger monthly budget for the team
Show the answer

Answer: B. Spreading across zones removes the single point of failure and supports high availability.

S5A team defines that 99.9 percent of requests must succeed each month. What is this?

  • AA service level indicator, a measurement
  • BA service level objective, a target
  • CA service level agreement, a contract
  • DAn error report, a list of failures
Show the answer

Answer: B. The target for an indicator is a service level objective.

S6Which of the following is a contract that promises a level of service and a remedy if it is not met?

  • AAn SLI, which measures behavior
  • BAn SLA, which is the service contract
  • CAn SLO, which sets an internal target
  • DA quota, which limits resource use
Show the answer

Answer: B. A service level agreement is the contract with the promised level and remedy.

6.2 Recall questions

R1What are the four golden signals?

Show the answer

Latency, traffic, saturation, errors.

R2Which product shows logs?

Show the answer

Cloud Logging.

R3What does Error Reporting do?

Show the answer

Collects and groups application errors.

R4What does SLO stand for?

Show the answer

Service level objective.

R5What is an error budget?

Show the answer

How much unreliability the SLO allows.

R6Name two resilience techniques.

Show the answer

For example redundancy and replication.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact

Resilience redundancy, replication, scalability, backups; zones for HA, regions for DR
Golden signals latency, traffic, saturation, errors
SRE SLI measures, SLO targets, SLA promises; error budget
